name: inputs
title: Inputs
about: Every way of answering a question: pick one of several answers, set a slider on a scale, type a number, put things in order, match pairs, or tap the spot on a figure. It knows nothing about the question; a lesson says what to show and what counts as right.

options.about: The answers to pick from. Each has an id and its words.

shuffle.about: Mix the answers up each time, so their place gives nothing away. Order always starts out of order.

min.about: The low end of the scale. On a number, the lowest that can be typed.

max.about: The high end of the scale. On a number, the highest that can be typed.

step.about: What the value moves in: 1, 0.5, 0.1 and so on.

scale.about: Log stretches the scale, for answers that run over powers of ten. Needs min above 0.

unit.about: Shown after the value, like °C or km.

ticks.about: How many numbers to write under the scale.

start.about: Where the slider starts, with its fill showing: a real value, never a blank. Left out, the middle of the scale. Keep it well away from the answer: a start inside the right band gives the answer away.

picture.about: A picture above the slider that follows the value. warmth: a ball that goes from a snowflake (low) to a fire (high), for temperature. depth: the sea cut away, with a warm layer as deep as the value.

pictureFrom.about: The value where the picture is at its low end (the snowflake; no warm layer). Left out, the low end of the scale.

pictureTo.about: The value where the picture is at its high end (the fire; the warm layer to the floor). Left out, the high end of the scale.

items.about: The things to put in order.

ends.about: Words for the two ends of the order, like First and Last.

right.about: The right column. Each left one pairs with exactly one of these.

figure.about: The picture to tap on: a path to a picture in the topic. Left empty, a sample drawing.

aspect.about: The picture's height over its width, so the space is kept before it loads.

reveal.about: Shows the truth beside what was given: the right choice, the true value on the scale, the right order or pairs, the right spot.

mark.about: Colours the answer given on a slider or a number: right, close or wrong.

lock.about: Stops any more changes, once an answer has been checked.

reset.about: Clears the answer and starts again.

value.about: choice: the id picked. slider and number: the number. order: the ids in order. match: { leftId: rightId }. spot: { x, y } from 0 to 1 across and down the picture.

answered.about: Whether there is enough of an answer to check: something picked, a number typed, every pair made, a spot tapped. A slider and an order count as answered from the start: they always hold a real answer.

marking.about: How a Check step's answer becomes a rule (see docs/format.md). $answer is the step's answer, $within its tolerance, $close its wider tolerance for 'close'.

choice.answer: the id of the right option

order.answer: the ids in the right order

match.answer: { leftId: rightId } for every left one

needs.weight: Light: a few dozen elements, no canvas, nothing to download.
